title: feat: Implement CQRS Event-Sourced Persistence for Workflows

raw.title: feat: Implement CQRS Event-Sourced Persistence for Workflows
raw.body:
## Summary
- Implemented robust database migrations for `arazzo_definitions`, `arazzo_executions`, and `arazzo_events`.
- Created `DatabaseDefinitionRegistry` with content-based hashing and `DatabaseExecutionRegistry` for idempotent workflow starts.
- Implemented `DatabaseEventLedger` to capture CQRS step events.
- Rewrote `StepExecutionWorker` to securely lock executions by ID and hydrate state directly from the data store.
- Re-wired `LaravelArazzoServiceProvider` to bootstrap the persistence layer automatically.

## Test Plan
- [x] All 305 Pest tests pass cleanly.
- [x] PHPStan strict static analysis passes.
- [x] Code style formatted via Pint.
